remainingAdmissionBeforeCaseEntry: The independent evaluator commits original plan/candidate/config/catalog/runtime/dataset bindings for the single pair before its first provider call.
Both arms retain the original required CM capabilities, cases, criteria, provider roles, single sample envelope and cancellation/accounting boundaries.
No additional epoch, hidden retry, production gateway mount, usage reset or changed scorer is authorized.
limits: GO is a public source/configuration admission review for the already declared one CM pair, one epoch; no score or semantic result is supplied.
Installed Eva2 functionality has not been removed by this isolated comparison setting.
Procedure reuse and autonomy are excluded from this variant claim; a CM result cannot settle those product outcomes.
Actual resource readiness and zero pre-case attempts are evaluator-reported metadata, explicitly distinguished from reviewer source inspection.
Bottie process/lease/fresh state and protected curation/scoring remain the independent evaluator responsibility; reviewer reads no cases, oracle, scorer or previous private launcher.
All earlier setup failures and output paths remain retained; no unmodified retry or better-score rerun is approved.
